body: Nit: this still says each of the five answered at the next probe after the wake gave up. The ticket's self-review says that claim was removed, and the log shows four of the five machines were replaced before anyone could tell. Keep only what the log proves: bx_eva5rxgz was kept and served on the next send.

Should-fix: `m1.daemonAnswers` sends this test down the loop road (runtime.ts:3686). A BoxMachine has no `daemonAnswers`, so a real Box wake takes the previewUrl dial (runtime.ts:3706-3720), whose failure reads `daemon on X did not answer within N ms (daemon link timed out ...)`, as all five lines in the host log do. The budget reaches both roads the same way, so the fix holds. Either add a preview-road case, or say here and on the ticket that this road stands in for Box's and why.

body: Should-fix (not on this line, but this line causes it): `pingDaemon` (runtime.ts:3683) never reads the wake's stop signal, and `stopWake` awaits the wake. A scratch probe on this branch: stop pulled 10 s into a wake whose daemon never answers, stopWake resolved at 300000 ms. The app's toggle on a waking row is that call. Race both of pingDaemon's roads against `entry.wakeStop`. The same number also widens the create's preview mint and daemon ask (runtime.ts:5241, 5250) to 5 minutes, which the PR should say.
